claim: Assess whether selected D-initial construction distinguishes candidate IV.173/Fr 1385 from shared-style different-book controls.
prior_exposure: All candidate and control photographs have been inspected before this protocol; exploratory, not blind or preregistered.
selection: Compare the D beginning Dignare in IV.173 PDF page 2 with the D beginning Dabit in Fr 1385 image 1; reuse E20 D examples in the published different-book pair Fr 8201/8304. Contexts and roles differ. Fr 20274 is an accepted Fr 1385 same-book comparator, but the retained images show no suitable decorated D; that is a control limitation, not a claim about the whole book.
alternatives: shared artistic vocabulary or production across books
same book with variation between initials or sections
different decorators, visual damage, or unequal resolution
errors in letter or function identification
composite manuscript or incorrect published association
decision_rule: Do not infer same book, exclusion, hand, or feature rarity from a small selected comparison. Stronger discrimination requires role-matched D samples from confirmed same-book and different-book material.
resource_assumption: 208 working source files and conservative 1675860841-byte transfer plan including 1GB reserve before this request; exact historic traffic unmeasured.
